name: SmartGlove
postCreateCommand: bash -lc 'cd ~ && cargo +stable install espup --locked && cargo +stable install espflash --locked && espup install && for rc in ~/.bashrc ~/.zshrc; do touch "$rc"; grep -qxF "source \"$HOME/export-esp.sh\"" "$rc" || echo "source \"$HOME/export-esp.sh\"" >> "$rc"; done'
